sections.title: The Chancery Hotel · Reservations and Your Stay

items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: The check-in time at The Chancery Hotel is 2:00 pm and the check-out time is 12:00 pm. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability.

items.question: Can I book a room at The Chancery Hotel directly through the website?
items.answer: Yes. Select Book Now to view available rooms, rates and offers for your preferred travel dates.

items.question: Is breakfast included with my stay at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: Breakfast or meal inclusions depend on your selected room or package. Please check the booking details for more information.

items.question: Can you arrange an airport transfer?
items.answer: Yes. Our team would be pleased to arrange airport transfers on request. Please contact the hotel in advance to check for availability and charges.

items.question: What general amenities are available at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: The Chancery Hotel offers all-day multi-cuisine dining at South Parade and authentic Japanese cuisine at Matsuri. Guests also have access to a fitness centre, Sara Spa, 24-hour in-room dining, daily turndown service, a business centre, valet parking, wake-up calls, and Wi-Fi and LAN connectivity.

items.question: Is in-room dining available at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Our 24-hour in-room dining menu offers a selection of dishes to enjoy in the comfort of your room, including Japanese specialities from Matsuri.

items.question: Does The Chancery Hotel offer a business centre?
items.answer: Yes. Business centre facilities are available at The Chancery Hotel. For specific services or assistance during your stay, please contact the front desk.

items.question: Are pets allowed at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: Pets are not currently accommodated at The Chancery Hotel.

items.question: What dining options are available at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: The Chancery Hotel is home to Matsuri, a well-known authentic Japanese restaurant curated by Chef Okada, and round-the-clock, multi-cuisine dining at South Parade.

items.question: Can guests who are not staying at The Chancery Hotel visit the restaurants?
items.answer: Certainly. The Chancery Hotel welcomes both in-house guests and visitors to South Parade and Matsuri. To reserve a table at either restaurant, simply give us a call at 080 4118 8888.

sections.title: The Chancery Hotel · Meetings and Events

items.question: How do I enquire about an event venue at The Chancery Hotel?
items.answer: To book or enquire about a venue for your event, kindly write to our sales team at sales@chanceryhotels.com.

items.question: Does The Chancery Hotel offer outdoor catering services?
items.answer: Yes. The Chancery Hotel offers outdoor catering for weddings, corporate events, premium cocktail events and private celebrations. Kindly write to our ODC team at ban.tch@chanceryhotels.com or simply give us a call at +91 91489 97818.

items.question: Can The Chancery Hotel assist guests with accessibility requirements?
items.answer: Yes. The hotel offers step-free access in key areas and lift access. Please let us know your specific requirements when booking so our team can advise on suitable room arrangements and assist with your stay.
